models.name: multi_user_todo_guests
models.description:
Guest accounts for unauthenticated visitors identified by device or session.

This table represents temporary guest identities that allow unauthenticated visitors to interact with the system. Guests are identified by device information rather than credentials, enabling immediate access without registration.

**Key Characteristics:**
- Temporary identity for unauthenticated users
- Device-based identification (no email/password required)
- Soft-deletable to support account cleanup
- Supports session-based tracking via {@link multi_user_todo_guest_sessions}

**Relationships:**
- Has many {@link multi_user_todo_guest_sessions} (1:N) - Tracks active guest sessions
- Can own todos and other domain entities (through sessions)

**Lifecycle:**
Guests are created when an unauthenticated visitor first accesses the system. They may optionally be converted to registered members. When permanently deleted, all associated data (todos, history) is cascaded per business requirements.

plainFields.name: device_id
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier for guest recognition. Used to associate returning visitors with their previous guest account when no session token is available.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the guest account is considered deleted but data is retained for potential recovery or audit purposes.

models.name: multi_user_todo_guest_sessions
models.description:
Guest session records tracking temporary access tokens for unauthenticated visitors.

Stores session metadata including IP address, browser href, and referrer information to provide audit trails of guest activity. Each session is associated with a guest record and has an expiration time for security.

References {@link multi_user_todo_guests} for the guest actor identity. Sessions are append-only records that expire after a defined period.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced guest actor's {@link multi_user_todo_guests.id}. Links the session to a specific guest identity for tracking temporary access.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address during session establishment. Used for audit and security tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer href from the client request headers. Used for audit trail.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the source page. Used for audit trail and access tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created. Not null - sessions are append-only audit records.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Sessions automatically become invalid after this time for security.

models.name: multi_user_todo_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email and password credentials.

This table serves as the identity record for authenticated users (members) in the system.
Members register with unique email addresses and passwords, which are used for authentication.
This is the canonical actor table for the member type, serving as the root of ownership
and permission relationships. All todos, edit histories, and trash items are owned by
members through foreign key relationships.

Each member can have multiple active sessions ({@link multi_user_todo_member_sessions}),
and may have password reset tokens ({@link multi_user_todo_member_password_resets}) during
account recovery workflows.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the member's login identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication. Stores the cryptographic hash, never the plain text password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted. Null if account is active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated member users in the todo application.

This table stores JWT authentication sessions with both access and refresh tokens, enabling secure user authentication and token refreshing capabilities. Each session tracks connection metadata including IP address, referrer URL, and browser information for security auditing purposes.

Sessions have a defined lifecycle:
- Created when a member successfully logs in
- Expires after a configured time period (expired_at field)
- Can be terminated early through logout operations

Reference: {@link multi_user_todo_members}

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated member who owns this session. Links to {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token used for authenticating API requests. Contains encoded user identity and permissions with limited lifespan.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token used to obtain new access tokens when the current access token expires. Has a longer lifespan than access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that established this session. Used for security auditing and detecting suspicious access patterns.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL or path from which the session was initiated. Captures the entry point of the user's login request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the previous page the user came from before logging in. Used for analytics and security.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and becomes invalid. Access tokens cannot be refreshed after this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was first created upon successful authentication.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery.

Stores temporary tokens used for password reset flows. When a member requests a password reset, a token is generated and stored here with an expiration time. The member receives this token via email and can use it to establish a new password. Tokens are time-constrained for security and are soft-deleted after use or expiration.

Belongs to {@link multi_user_todo_members} table through member relationship.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}. Links the reset token to the member account requesting password recovery.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token. Cryptographically secure random string sent to member's email for account recovery.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. After this time, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used for password reset. Ensures time-bound security for reset operations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Set when token is used for password reset or when manually invalidated.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos
models.description:
Core todo task entity representing a task owned by a member user.

Each todo has a title and optional description, with scheduling support via start_date and due_date fields. The completion status is tracked through is_complete boolean and completed_at timestamp. Todos support soft deletion for trash functionality via deleted_at.

Relationships with other models:
- Belongs to {@link multi_user_todo_members} via member_id - the owner who created the todo
- Has many {@link multi_user_todo_histories} via todoId - edit history records
- Has one {@link multi_user_todo_trashes} when soft deleted - trash bin entry

Business constraints: Todos are scoped to their owner member. When permanently deleted, associated history records are also removed.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Owner member's {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}. References the authenticated member who created and owns this todo.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title or name. The brief identifier shown in todo lists and used as the primary display text for the task.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed task description. Optional extended text providing additional context, instructions, or notes about the todo.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Planned start date for the task. Optional date when work on this todo is scheduled to begin. Used for sorting and filtering.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Deadline date for the task. Optional date by which this todo should be completed. Used for sorting and filtering.

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description: Completion status flag. True when the todo has been marked as done/finished, false when still pending.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was marked complete. Set when is_complete transitions from false to true, null when incomplete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Set when the todo is first created and never modified.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp. Updated whenever any todo field is modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when the todo is moved to trash, null when active. Used for trash functionality.

models.name: multi_user_todo_histories
models.description:
Historical edit records tracking changes made to todos over time.

Each entry captures the state of a todo after a modification, including the
values that were applied during the edit (title, description, start date,
due date, and completion status). Entries are ordered chronologically with
most recent first, enabling members to view the complete modification
history of their todos. When a todo is permanently deleted, all associated
history entries are cascade removed.

References {@link multi_user_todo_todos.id} for the associated todo.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: The todo this history entry belongs to. {@link multi_user_todo_todos.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title value after this edit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: The description value after this edit.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: The start date after this edit.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: The due date after this edit.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: The completion status after this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history entry was created.
